w: Swamishri sanctified the newly built girls hostel by Dr. K. C. Patel in Vidyanagar.

Swamishri arrived in Mahelav at 11.30 am and did darshan of Shastriji Maharaj's birthplace and the place where he played the 'maan' and delivered discourses on the Mahabharat. On arriving at the mandir, Swamishri was welcomed by a dance performed by children. Beneath the mandir dome a classroom had been set up with a banner 'Yagnapurush Pathshala' and children were seated on the benches. Swamishri recited the dhun, explained it and introduced the murtis in the mandir. After a welcome ceremony Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Swamishri left Mahelav and arrived at Bochasan at 7.40 pm.
Swamishri participated in the ceremony for the fifth patotsav of Surat mandir.
In the evening, Swamishri blessed the Swaminrayan Mahamantra Bicentenary assembly.
Swamishri sanctified the newly built Sanskardham in Saraspur. After performing pujan and arti of the murtis Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Obedience to the commands of the Satpurush is equivalent to atma-gnan. (15 Dec 02)
The extent of the Satpurush's commands one obeys, that much of inward-vision is attained, darshan of atma is attained, experience of atma is consolidated, ego, jealousy, anger, etc. (15 Dec 02)
Changing Ourselves

11 December (V.S. 2059, Magshar sud 7) Wednesday, Amdavad Mr Gurucharansingh, the election commissioner of Gujarat, came for Swamishri's darshan at the Swaminarayan Mandir. Having read the Shikshapatri, Gurucharansingh desired to know if two shlokas were to be added to the Shikshapatri than what two things would Swamishri incorporate.

Swamishri replied, "Bhagwan Swaminarayan has written the Shikshapatri properly which includes everything. There is no need for any addition. By reading it and obeying it with the fullest understanding, includes everything."
"But according to our modern age if you wish to add anything, then ..." Gurucharansingh asked.

"It is man who has to change. No change needs to be made in the Shikshapatri. There won't be any problems if one obeys its instructions; has faith in God and lives an addiction-free and moral life." Swamishri advised.

Then someone added that the election commissioner has a lot of tension because of his responsibilities. Swamishri blessed Gurucharansingh by placing his hand on his head and said, "Pray to God before you go to sleep at night and remember Him when you wake up in the morning. By praying to God you'll have no tension and experience peace."
Swamishri gave a rosary to Gurucharansingh and told him to say five rosaries every morning.
Spiritual Awakening

14 December (V.S. 2059, Magshar sud 10) Saturday, Amdavad After performing the shangar arti Swamishri did darshan of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Then on not seeing Rahul among the sadhaks from America, Swamishri asked as to where he was.
"He is writing letters," a sadhak replied.

Swamishri responded, "Writing letters, now! One should be present when it is arti time, have lunch during lunchtime, and do darshan during darshan time. Do whatever is to be done according to the time schedules. One should perform one's spiritual rituals properly."
Swamishri advised the sadhaks and induced a spiritual awakening

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
6 Dec 2002, Gandhinagar

Swamishri blessed Ashwin, a young boy, who had fasted for 82 hours to please him on his 82nd birthday celebration. 12 kishores from G.E.B. Starting at 1:00 a.m. 51 disabled children from Unvarsad village walked to Gandhinagar. Swamishri blessed all the boys. Two ten year olds were also blessed by Swamishri for having prostrated from Sector 17 in Gandhinagar to the mandir.
8 Dec 2002, Himmatnagar
Swamishri blessed 14 devotees from Dali who had pilgrimaged by foot (219 km) for the birthday celebration.
9 Dec 2002, Amdavad
Swamishri blessed 6 youths from Masad, Rayam and Kadod villages (sub district: Bardoli) who had cycled 400km from Sankari to Himmatnagar on the occasion of his birthday celebration in Himmatnagar.

Prior to his morning puja at the C.U. Shah Bhavan hall, Swamishri went for Thakorji's darshan. A few South Indian Brahmins chanted the ‘Purushsukta' with gentle tune of the Swaminarayan dhun being played on the nadswaram. Pujya Viveksagar Swami commenced his discourse on the Kathopanishad during the evening assembly at the C.U. Shah Bhavan hall.

After his morning puja Swamishri and the congregation of sadhus and devotees chanted dhun following the demise of Haka Bapu in Sarangpur, a veteran devotee who had served Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj all his life. Swamishri sent a sanctified garland with Viveksagar Swami and sadhus who travelled to Sarangpur for the last rites. Swamishri eulogized Haka Bapu’s services, “He was inclined towards listening to and delivering spiritual discourses. He inspired satsang in Chitrasar, Mahijada, Vasai, Navagam, Bareja and other places. He was an all-rounder. He was successful in any task given to him. He had a humorous nature and was social so everyone liked him.”

In Dhanurmas (the month of Dhanu), Thakorji goes to study. The special meaning of this is that Thakorji teaches everyone. From today, the Thakorji residing in Pramukh Swami Maharaj had resolved to give lessons on the occasion of Dhanurmas. On the occasion of Dhanurmas, Swamishri began from today to write various spiritual aphorisms. Today's first lesson was: "The one knowledge truly worth studying is Brahmavidya, so study that knowledge."
A devotee phoned from America. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "For many days I have been phoning to get Pramukh Swami Maharaj's blessings."
Swamishri said, "I am Pramukh Swami speaking."
The devotee said, "Please remain pleased with me." Saying this much, he put down the phone.

ds.t: Throw it all in the sea
w: A young devotee phoned. He could not sleep at night and had to take pills. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Will I have to take pills my whole life?"
Swamishri said, "We are not to think such thoughts at all."
The seeker said, "Until now I have done many things I should not have done; I feel I will have to suffer for them."
Swamishri immediately said, "Throw all of that into the sea."
"These thoughts come even during my puja."
Swamishri said, "Leave all that and remember God."
The seeker said, "I try to drive the thoughts out, but I can't. I never turned the mala from the start, so I get bored turning the mala."
Swamishri said, "Keep turning the mala; there will be no problem. We will pray to God. Forget everything."
By standing by many such people, Swamishri has breathed peace into their lives.

Today, after installing murtis in an industrial complex in the village of Sari, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was returning to Silvassa, recalling the story of the black sparrow in Yogiji Maharaj's teaching stories, he said:
"When the black sparrow passes three times, think of Maharaj, Swami and the Satpurush. Then no obstacle will trouble you. Sooner or later he will make it clear and carry you across."

He added, "The eye should not flicker, that is, no seeing him as human, wondering 'Is it so or not?' Keep a sense of divinity, no doubt at all." Then teaching the way, he said, "First have trust. Then divinity comes."
In this connection the sadhus said, "You once said that you never saw Yogibapa and Pramukh Swami Maharaj as human."
Swamishri agreed with this.
Then the sadhus described some situations and asked him, "In such circumstances, did questions not arise in you?"
"Everything belongs to Maharaj and Swami. They are the doers. Whatever they do, they do for the good," Swamishri said.
"Did you not feel like clearing up misunderstandings?"
"No."
"Why?"
"Everything belongs to God. He is the one who does it and the one who will do it," Swamishri said.

In his every word, his high spiritual state was seen. Then the talk took a turn and the sadhus asked, "At the start of satsang, while we are being shaped, out of ignorance we may wrong devotees. Later, when understanding comes, we realise their glory and repent. So do we incur the karma of having wronged them?"
"No," Swamishri said.
"Is all that forgiven?"
"Yes."
In this context the sadhus raised a new question: "Often when we ask you, you say, 'I think about glory.' So what do you think about in it?"

"Everyone is divine. It is after countless merits that this association with satsang has come about. It has not happened just like that. So these people may look ordinary, may be aged, may look old, but their form is like Indra and Brahma. They may look ugly, they may look handsome; Maharaj has made all that. Otherwise everyone is extremely beautiful, so look at them that way." Swamishri revealed his divine vision.
In this connection the sadhus asked, "When you go out, you must feel immense joy meeting devotees, don't you?"
"Yes, very much. How meritorious they are! Satsang does not happen just like that. It comes at the end of much merit," Swamishri said.

While this interesting and instructive conversation went on, they reached the mandir courtyard. Then the sadhus asked, "We have seen that you feel great joy when meeting devotees and when having darshan of God's murti. So in what other things do you find joy?"
"Everything is included in that..." Swamishri said.

Bhagwan Swaminarayan says, "I have a relationship in every way with whoever is a devotee of God; and without devotees of God, the wealth of the fourteen worlds is like straw to me..." Swamishri too has such love for devotees.

ds.t: If you stay, we will keep you
w: Today, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was entering the dining room for his evening meal, a youth named Maulik asked, "Swami! You will keep me in the beads of your mala, won't you?"
"If you stay, we will keep you," Swamishri answered clearly. In this answer, along with his grace, our own effort is also expected.

ds.t: The sticks were taller than you
w: Today, seeing Harikrishnabhai Bhatt, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "You were in the raas (stick dance)! The sticks (dandiyas) were longer than you..."
Overcome with wonder, Harikrishnabhai said, "Swami! You still remember that!"

He explained, "This is about the children's and youth convention held in Gondal in 1971. I was five years old. So that I could not reach the top, the dandiyas had been kept even taller than me. At the end Bapa found me in the group, lifted me and put me in front, and Swami (Mahant Swami Maharaj) was sitting at the side. But he has remembered this from 46 years ago!"
The beautiful darshan of smruti (memory), one of the 39 auspicious qualities of God described in the Bhagavat, is seen in Swamishri at every step.
